notes: Prior 2 mediums FIXED. Every Vulkan/rendering sentence in the whole PR diff checked against code on origin/master. soft-bodies.html:217 'Vulkan draws it only when the material is Unlit (stages A and B of #43): lit (the default) has no Vulkan material until stage C, so a lit soft body is not drawn': Material.hpp:76 Material::Create defaults ShadingModel::Lit; GpuCache.cpp:332-333 picks GetStandardLitShader for any non-Unlit shading (Lit and Pbr); VulkanDraw.cpp:1027-1030 GetStandardLitShader logs once (LogUnsupportedOnce) and returns nullptr; VulkanDraw.cpp:1049-1054 CreateMaterial refuses any shader but the unlit built-in (LogOnce 'lit: stage C'); MeshDrawing.cpp:146-150 null gpuMaterial skips the submesh. testing.html:494 'draws only meshes with an unlit material (stages A and B of #43; lit in stage C), station bodies use lit materials, so no bodies': lua_project/assets/materials/softbody_{blue,cyan,green,red,yellow}.mat all "shading": "lit"; SoftBodies.lua:23,31 uses them. particles.html Vulkan sentence 'unlit meshes draw, no blending, a blended draw such as a particle billboard is drawn opaque with one log line until stage D': ParticleSystem.cpp:475 uses GetStandardUnlitShader (so billboards get a Vulkan material); VulkanDraw.cpp:1176-1178 if state.blend, LogOnce('blending is not implemented yet (stage D of #43): blended draws are drawn opaque'); VulkanDraw.cpp:837-839 blendEnable = VK_FALSE; VulkanDraw.cpp:14 header says only unlit is handed out and drawn. testing.html:487 'Vulkan draws them opaque for now, as it has no blending yet' same evidence. 'no test draws particles on it' not contradicted by anything found. GPU-verification wording (particles.html callout, physics.html Not verified in CI x2): maintainer, Windows PC with NVIDIA GPU, 2026-10-14, golden test + checklist passed; no GPU model, no numbers; not recorded: VRAM/timings, preset tuning, solver offsets/max velocity; other GPUs/vendors/drivers and Linux (GPU asset deferred) unverified; checklist link kept; no claim beyond what the maintainer reported. Diff vs origin/master touches only docs/particles.html, physics.html, soft-bodies.html, testing.html (8 insertions, 7 deletions). Line endings: the committed blobs are LF on both master and the branch in all four files (0 CR bytes both sides, same line counts +1 for particles), so endings are unchanged by the diff. No Co-Authored-By or 'Generated with Claude Code' in the branch commits. Docs-only; CI cannot judge prose.
